report.title: Live spending reports stopped updating
report.body: I have spending report cards on my dashboard set to Live, and they used to switch to the new month automatically when the month changed. Now they stay stuck on the month they were created in, like a static report. My Net Worth and other report cards still update fine.

rootCause.summary: For a live single-month spending report with a saved `compare` month, this branch returns the saved month verbatim instead of the current month, so a Live dashboard card never slides to the new month. The branch was added in 2c3e2a34f to preserve saved selections in the editor, but `SpendingCard` also calls this function with the card's saved meta, so Live cards are frozen on their creation month.

path.title: SpendingCard (dashboard card)
path.value: calls calculateSpendingReportTimeRange(meta) with the saved meta

path.title: calculateSpendingReportTimeRange(meta)
path.value: live + single-month + saved compare '2016-12' returns '2016-12' instead of the current month '2017-01'

names: calculateSpendingReportTimeRange live dashboard cards moves a live single-month spending card to the current month
